description: Create house.cleaning_product, measured by volume or mass and flagged where it is hazardous.
rationale: Bleach and dishwasher salt are bought by very different units, so the unit is a column rather than an assumption. hazardous is the one flag that changes where a thing may be stored.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category cleaning_product. One row per house.item row.

columns.name: net_volume
columns.comment: Net quantity in the container, in volume_unit. Named volume even where the unit is a mass, because that is what the label calls it.

columns.name: hazardous
columns.comment: Whether it must be kept away from food and out of reach. Drives where it may be stored.

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.comment: Last day the maker vouches for it. Null for products that do not carry one.

columns.name: scent
columns.comment: Fragrance as sold: 'lemon', 'unscented'. Null where the label says nothing.

intents.name: cleaning_product_hazardous_idx
intents.comment: Partial: the hazardous shortlist is short and is the only subset anybody audits.
